publication_source.title: Збирка на судски одлуки 1990–1996 — Книга V

rules: Standalone extracts are publication-bound to Collection V but not treated as remote original decisions.
All records are historical and require current-law verification before present-law use.
Multiple headnotes for the same case/date are merged as one authority record with multiple propositions.
Commercial Court decisions remain a distinct authority class from Supreme Court decisions.
Principled legal opinion preserves its General Session subtype and is not relabelled as a judgment.
